event: Pakistan Floods 2022 - Khairpur District, Sindh agricultural impact reference
intended_use: Historical agricultural-impact context for the 2022 Khairpur flood event
District-level contextual comparison with AgriFlood-PK outputs
not_intended_use: Direct supervision of Low, Moderate, or Severe ML classes
Proof that an individual sampled location experienced crop damage

ml_label_policy.reason: District-level affected-area totals do not provide spatially explicit damage severity for individual pixels or samples.
ml_label_policy.required_for_training: Independent spatial reference data or a documented reference-sampling and expert-label methodology.

scientific_note: The statistics are preserved as an external district-level historical reference. They must remain separate from Sentinel-1 flood candidates, Sentinel-2 vegetation change, and future ML predictions.
